answer:
Sir Charles Tupper was the last surviving Canadian Father of Confederation, dying in October 1915 at the age of 94.

His father was **Rev. Charles Tupper** (also known as Dr. Charles Tupper). He was a Baptist minister born around 1795 in Cornwallis, Nova Scotia. Charles Tupper Jr. (the politician) was born on July 2, 1821, in Amherst, Nova Scotia, to Rev. Charles Tupper and Miriam Lowe (née Lockhart).
